$comment: Issue #105: pinned local CPU model identity for the default LocalCpuInferenceClient.
Selection. The original issue title pinned 'Phi-3-mini Q4_0 GGUF' as the aspirational target with a TinyLlama-class fallback. Two reasons drove the actual selection below:
1. CI cold-start + one classifyLink call must complete in under 2 minutes on a single CI core (issue #105 acceptance criterion).

2. The repo's runtime model toolchain is @xenova/transformers (already a project dependency for embeddings); switching to a llama.cpp/GGUF path requires a separate native-binary integration that was deferred.

For link classification (5-class: supports / contradicts / elaborates / overrides / is-exception-to / none) we do NOT need a full instruction-tuned LLM. A small NLI-based zero-shot classifier is the right primitive: it directly scores 'does premise X entail label hypothesis Y?' which is exactly the link-relation question. The selected model (Xenova/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall) is ~88 MB ONNX-quantized, sub-second per pair on CPU, fits the 2-minute cold-start + one-call budget with margin, and runs in-process under the existing transformers.js pipeline so no new dependency is needed.

Verifying. Run `npm run fetch-model`. The script downloads each file from `url` if missing under models/cache/<huggingface_id>/, verifies the SHA-256 against this manifest, and aborts on mismatch. A no-op on a warm cache.
Updating. Bump `revision` to a new HF commit, re-run the fetch script with `--update` to recompute the SHAs, and commit the resulting manifest.json plus models/MODEL_LOCKFILE.md.

nli-deberta-v3-xsmall.purpose: Zero-shot NLI classifier used by LocalCpuInferenceClient.classifyLink to score the 5 SIGNALS relation labels (supports / contradicts / elaborates / overrides / is-exception-to) as hypotheses against a block-pair premise.

fallback_ladder.rejected_reason: Cold-start download alone exceeds the 2-minute single-CI-core budget. Also requires a llama.cpp native binary integration outside the in-process @xenova/transformers toolchain.
640 MB cold-cache download plus native llama.cpp build still over budget on the standard CI runner; same toolchain mismatch as Phi-3.
Larger than nli-deberta-v3-xsmall; held in reserve as a quality-bump fallback.
Comparable size to deberta-v3-xsmall but lower-quality on cross-encoder NLI benchmarks; held in reserve as a footprint fallback.
